application_received.text: Application-XEW1 was received with the two assessed public-data coursework artifacts labeled honestly as coursework, not paid employment; no confidential employer data was included, and there is no job offer and no resignation.

artifacts_assessed.text: The independent course assessor issued two passed public-synthetic artifacts authored by Claire Bennett: project-map (a process map of a synthetic support-ticket workflow) and project-metrics (a metrics note on a supplied public synthetic dataset).

enrolled.text: An approved enrollment in course-bridge (two weeks, six hours weekly, 300 USD) was recorded before the 2027-02-02 18:00 Central enrollment deadline; the 300 USD invoice is due and unpaid, and enrolling does not complete the course or the projects.

role_v2.text: The recruiter-confirmed product-operations brief is role-ops version 2: it requires two assessed deliverables, a process map and a metrics note; the resume-only version 1 brief is superseded, and assessed coursework clearly labeled as coursework is accepted. Confidential employer materials are not requested.
